mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS MoM decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 100,000 jobs in a month, the combined signal indicates significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive, the combination signals robust supply-side strength and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
